name: Homura
silhouette: Compact fox with one curled wick tail and a low forward body line; keep the existing original sprite.
motion: Quick two-step scurry; tail settles a beat later.

name: Homura Hearthkeeper
silhouette: Longer low fox with a broad ceramic hearth mantle and three ash fins, retaining its single tail; never add multiple tails.
motion: Plants the mantle before tracing a deliberate floor line.

name: Midori
silhouette: The existing hovering leaf spirit, with its broad leaf body and visible seed core.
motion: Soft side-to-side float with an asymmetric leaf fold.

name: Midori Canopykeeper
silhouette: An inverted umbrella of three leaves with a suspended seed and visible braided root hem.
motion: Opens the canopy, then anchors roots before a shield appears.

name: Fuuri
silhouette: Keep the cream moth-spirit, lavender feather-like wings and split ribbon tail already in the campaign.
motion: Unequal wingbeats create a visible gust; ribbon follows the turn.

name: Fuuri Windweaver
silhouette: A spindle-bodied silk moth with four narrow sail panels and a woven open loop trailing below.
motion: Tilts the panels in sequence to draw curved air paths.

name: Kohaku
silhouette: Keep the three segmented amber plates, two moss sprouts and tiny feet; it is not a turtle.
motion: Short deliberate steps; the three plates compress during guard.

name: Kohaku Archwarden
silhouette: Four pillar feet carry an open amber arch with a hollow center and moss lintel, not a larger solid shell.
motion: Pillars spread and the arch locks; rocks chime once on impact.
role: Stationary two-hit defense with a mobility cost

name: Dewspindle
silhouette: A translucent spiral droplet suspended from two reed-like legs, with no fish or amphibian outline.
motion: Alternating stilt steps draw tiny circular ripples.

name: Tidewheel
silhouette: A vertical ring of water turns around a hollow reed axle; two spoon-shaped feet skim pools.
motion: Wheel rotates while feet stay level, then unwinds into a linking strand.

name: Chimeclasp
silhouette: A spring-jawed bronze clasp on three unequal prongs, with one suspended tuning tongue.
motion: Coils, releases a tuning pin, then catches it with an audible clasp.

name: Spoolbud
silhouette: A low living thicket with a bobbin-shaped seed body, expressive knot face, leaf ears, four root paws and a vine-loop tail.
motion: Sniffs the rope end, gathers its paws, then rocks forward with a breathing seed body.

name: Loomcrown
silhouette: A tall long-legged thicket animal; arched shoulder branches frame an open trellis above its living face and chest.
motion: Leans into a two-point tether, ears focused; the vine tail slips through the open shoulder crown.

name: Cindertray
silhouette: A squat warm ceramic quadruped with rounded muzzle, amber eyes, handle-like ears, cheek vents and a triangular back plate.
motion: Pads toward warmth, crouches to breathe out heat, then raises its soft-looking ceramic ears.

name: Kilnbarrow
silhouette: A low elongated ceramic animal with broad forelegs, an expressive head and two kiln-like shoulder plates that open sideways.
motion: Lopes deliberately, carries a glowing heat drawer, and settles its side plates with a relieved exhale.

name: Tangleaper
silhouette: Wide-toed gecko with lifted eyes, short rounded muzzle and one long coiled vine tail.
motion: Alternating splayed-foot scuttle; watches its landing, coils, sidesteps and settles.

name: Boughvault
silhouette: Lean living gecko with connected leaf-like side membranes making a triangular gliding outline.
motion: Crouches with aimed eyes, hops through a banking arc, then folds its continuous membranes.

name: Duneroll
silhouette: Big-eared dune mammal with long hind feet, compact forepaws and a thin tufted tail.
motion: Ears tilt toward the slope; compresses its hind legs, kicks and lands in a short hop.
role: Short widening wedge and bounded push

name: Dunescoop
silhouette: Long low dune mammal weighted onto two broad digging forefeet beneath a raised ear arc.
motion: Low scoop-bound rhythm; plants its forefeet, turns its shoulders and lifts its muzzle.

name: Coalcoil
silhouette: A low snail with a broad smiling muzzle, two blunt eyestalks and a sideways crescent shell; pale foot clearly separate from charcoal shell.
motion: Foot ripples in four readable waves; shell rocks after the head stops.

name: Emberhelix
silhouette: A raised snail on a narrow long foot; its open spiral shell sits upright with a large triangular window and expressive face below.
motion: Stretch, brace, pull the shell forward; spiral tips lag by one pose.

name: Hearthcrown
silhouette: A long muscular snail with a flat fan-shaped shell held above its face on three connected shell ribs; large open spaces replace the earlier spiral.
motion: Wide foot fans to anchor, then contracts into an unhurried glide.

name: Shardibex
silhouette: A small round-nosed mountain goat with short straight stone horns, wide cloven feet and a tilted rectangular shoulder patch.
motion: Quick paired hoof plants, head dip, rear-foot catch-up.

name: Bracehorn
silhouette: A low broad-shouldered goat with huge outward U-curved horns enclosing its face, short hindquarters and distinctly spread forehooves.
motion: Three-beat brace and short forward shuffle; head stays level.
